newsitem.title: UK: Land leads rise in UK property stocks.
newsitem.headline: Land leads rise in UK property stocks.

text.p: Shares in UK property company Land Securities Plc led major developers and property stocks higher on Tuesday amid a flurry of interest in the sector, dealers said.
Land shares, heading volumes in the sector, hit a new year high of 715p in early trade, up 15p or 2.4 percent.
The stock slipped back to trade at 711.5p by 0815 GMT when the overall market was up 0.32 percent.
"We think there's a buy note on the sector and the plans for the Millenium Tower may have excited private investors. Volumes aren't all that terrific though," said a marketmaker.
An analyst, who asked not to be named, said fundamentals on the sector had shown recent improvement.
"We're starting to get a few surveys saying institutional investors are looking at better returns from property than, say, the gilts market," he said.
Other notable property stocks higher included Great Portland Estates Plc, up four pence at 190p, Slough Estates Plc, up seven pence at 250p, and British Land Co Plc, up seven pence at 472p.
